blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo. When you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting, you need a little English.

In this lesson you learn five useful words: computer, system, data, network and user. They are simple, but you hear them every day at work.

Go slowly — one step at a time. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: What does IT support at Czarnikow?
items.why: "IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo."

items.q: How many words do you learn in this lesson?
items.why: "you learn five useful words: computer, system, data, network and user."

items.q: When do you need this English?
options: When you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting
Only when you travel to London
items.why: "When you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting, you need a little English."

items.q: The words are described as simple, but the text says you hear them…
items.why: "They are simple, but you hear them every day at work."

items.q: "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts." This suggests that the author wants you to feel…
items.why: Inferência: a frase e o "You can do it!" mostram que o autor quer te deixar confiante.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James, do time de IT, dar as boas-vindas a um novo colega. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to Czarnikow. My name is James, and I am on the IT team. I help you with your computer, and I am happy you are here.

Let me show you three simple things. First, this is your computer. It is new, and it is ready. Second, this is our system. The system is where we keep your files. Third, this is the network. The network is how your computer talks to the office.

You are a user now. A user is a person with a login. Your data — your files and your work — is safe on the system. We check it every day.

If something is strange, do not worry. Call the help desk. We are a small team, but we are fast. Small IT habits today save big problems tomorrow. You can do it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is James?
options: A person on the IT team
items.why: "My name is James, and I am on the IT team."

items.q: What is the network, according to James?
options: How your computer talks to the office
items.why: "this is the network. The network is how your computer talks to the office."

items.q: What is a user?
items.why: "You are a user now. A user is a person with a login."

items.q: James says the team is small, but fast. This suggests that…
options: You will wait a long time for help
The team only works in London
The team does not answer calls
You can still get quick help
items.why: Inferência: "small team, but we are fast" mostra que a ajuda chega rápido.

items.q: How does James want the new colleague to feel?
items.why: Inferência: "Welcome", "do not worry" e "You can do it!" mostram um tom acolhedor e tranquilo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The computer is working well today." A computer is…
options: a phone call to the help desk
items.why: Computer = computador, a máquina em que você trabalha.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "There's a new ___ on the help desk board."
items.why: System = sistema, onde os arquivos e processos ficam.

items.q: "The data is ready for you to check." Data means…
items.why: Data = dados, os arquivos e informações.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We restart the ___ every evening, just in case."
items.why: Network = rede, o que conecta os computadores; é o que se reinicia à noite.

items.q: "The user is on the shared drive." A user is…
options: a person who uses the system
items.why: User = usuário, a pessoa que usa o sistema.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho com IT. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please log in with your name and password." To log in means to…
options: enter the system with your login
items.why: Log in = entrar no sistema com seu usuário e senha.

items.q: "If the computer is slow, please restart it." To restart means to…
options: turn it off and on again
items.why: Restart = reiniciar, desligar e ligar de novo.

items.q: "I need to set up your new computer." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = configurar, deixar pronto para usar.

items.q: "Sophie calls IT when something goes wrong." This means something…
items.why: Go wrong = dar problema, não funcionar.

items.q: "Can you help out with the network today?" To help out means to…
items.why: Help out = dar uma ajuda, colaborar.
